notes.title: Update the picture color richness and fix the lost archive problem
notes.content:
1. Fix archive loss

Now there is only one automatic archive, and the format of the archive name is "date_time", For example: the archive name is 20200803_ 085503, the storage time of the archive is 8:55:3, August 3, 2020, and the "automatic archive" is added after the date "_AutoSave"

2. Add style richness to various buttons to make them look more beautiful.

notes.title: Update the order of archive arrangement
notes.content:
A friend said that the archive disappeared after being saved. I don't know whether it is the reason why the archive is not in the front after saving. Therefore, the sorting order of archives is changed to sort according to the saving time, so as to find out the latest saved archives as soon as possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317200/ed8971c260ef5d1abab1368b7b944df7c68b5ec7.png[/img]
